recipes.name: crud-list-page
recipes.title: CRUD List Page
recipes.summary: Search + filters over a sortable, selectable, paginated table, with bulk actions and a guarded destructive path.
recipes.when: A list page whose rows are already in memory and the page needs filtering, sorting, multi-select, bulk actions, or a delete confirmation.
recipes.notWhen: The server does the filtering/sorting/slicing — use `server-side-table`. A read-only handful of rows with no interaction — use `Table` directly, no recipe needed.

recipes.name: server-side-table
recipes.title: Server-Side Table
recipes.summary: A table whose sorting and pagination round-trip to the server: the page owns the query state, the API returns one slice plus a total.
recipes.when: The API returns one pre-sorted page plus a total count, so the table can never know the full ordering — sorting and pagination must be controlled.
recipes.notWhen: All rows fit in memory — leave the table uncontrolled and use `crud-list-page`.

recipes.name: dashboard-page
recipes.title: Dashboard
recipes.summary: A KPI row over compact widget cards — sparkline trends and a recent-activity table in one responsive grid.
recipes.when: An overview page that answers 'is everything okay?' at a glance and links out for detail.
recipes.notWhen: The page IS the detail view, or the numbers need drill-down in place — build a list or detail page instead. Full charting belongs in a dedicated chart library, not `Sparkline`.

recipes.name: detail-drawer-page
recipes.title: Detail + Drawer Edit
recipes.summary: A record's read view with an edit drawer, a dirty-close guard, and a confirmed destructive action.
recipes.when: Editing a record while the user still needs the record on screen for reference.
recipes.notWhen: The edit should interrupt and take over (short one-shot forms, confirmations) — use `Modal`. A full create/edit page with many sections — use `form-page`.

recipes.name: form-page
recipes.title: Form Page
recipes.summary: A sectioned create/edit page: grouped fields, mixed control types, submit-time validation, and a guarded submit.
recipes.when: A create or edit page big enough to need sections, help text, and inline validation messages.
recipes.notWhen: The form is short enough to live in a drawer next to a read view — use `detail-drawer-page`.

recipes.name: tenant-admin-shell
recipes.title: Tenant Admin Shell
recipes.summary: The app frame: localized AdminLayout with permission-aware navigation, the signed-in user, and a tenant switcher.
recipes.when: Starting a multi-tenant admin app — this is the outermost shell every page renders inside.
recipes.notWhen: A single-tenant app with no tenant scope — use `AdminLayout` without `TenantSwitcher`.
